sees: frame 1: A grey cartoon boy in a cap with a satchel stands on the left. Next to him is a heart with a big dark X over it, labeled VALIDATION. Pale cafe-like background.

frame 2: A pink circle appears around the boy. A curved arrow runs from the boy to a new briefcase icon on the right, labeled PROFESSIONAL MINDSET. The VALIDATION label is partly overlapped by the new label.

frame 3: Same layout, slightly zoomed in. The boy is circled, the arrow points to the briefcase, and the crossed-out heart stays in the middle. The labels VALIDATION and PROFESSIONAL MINDSET overlap and touch.
changed: A briefcase labeled PROFESSIONAL MINDSET was added, the boy was circled, and an arrow was drawn from him to the briefcase.
cause: The boy (the person in the story) is shown shifting away from seeking validation toward a professional mindset.
effect: Validation is rejected and a professional mindset takes its place as what the person should rely on.
message: The narrator is saying you should not look for validation (a crossed-out heart) from others and should approach this with a professional mindset instead.
wouldConfuse: The VALIDATION and PROFESSIONAL MINDSET labels overlap and the first is cut off. The arrow starts at the boy and crosses over the crossed-out heart, so it is unclear whether the boy or the validation is being redirected. The top-right tag text is cut off.
